$:set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace('process.env.GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID','process.env.MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID').replace('process.env.GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET','process.env.MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.devcontainer/devcontainer.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
d['containerEnv']={'MCP_ALLOWED_GITHUB_LOGIN':'BestNameYet','MCP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN':'https://shiny-robot-3000.app.github.dev'}
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
node --check workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs
for f in workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/oauth.mjs .devcontainer/devcontainer.json; do
sha=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
gh api -X PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" -f message="Use valid Codespaces secret names and configure MCP OAuth environment" -f sha="$sha" -f content="$(base64 -w0 "$f")" --jq .commit.sha
done
